tasks.title: Create lean INDEX.md and context loading infrastructure
tasks.description: Build compressed agent/command index (~95 lines) with behavioral rules section, and implement JIT loading system with new file structure (van-context.md, taskmaster-reference.md, research-framework.md, hook-guide.md)
tasks.details:
Implementation:
1. Create .claude-collective/INDEX.md (~95 lines) as compressed index:
   - Agent catalog (15 agents, 1-2 line descriptions each)
   - Command catalog (~20 consolidated commands)
   - JIT loading instructions (when to load van-context, taskmaster-reference, etc.)
   - Format: Vercel AGENTS.md style - terse, scannable, passive reference
   - NEW: Behavioral Rules section (~15-20 lines) from Claude Code Insights report:
     a) After multi-file changes, grep codebase for remaining references to modified functions/constants/variables to catch missed locations
     b) After Drupal service/Twig changes, verify: service injections correct, DB table/column names exist, Twig filters actually exist in project (no non-existent filters like |clamp)
     c) Use system-configured values instead of hardcoding magic numbers (* 8 for hours, * 5 for weekdays) - search for existing config constants first
     d) When removing/disabling something, remove from ALL locations (controller, template, Twig, JS, config) and grep to confirm nothing missed
     e) Write output files to appropriate project directory, not inline in chat
     f) For CSS fixes, target specific elements within context (.parent .child) not parent containers
   - These rules address the #1 friction point: 26 buggy code events across 150 sessions

2. Create .claude-collective/van-context.md (~80 lines):
   - Move routing logic from CLAUDE.md
   - Agent selection matrices
   - Drupal-specific routing patterns
   - Only loaded when /van command is used

3. Create .claude-collective/taskmaster-reference.md (~100 lines):
   - Extract essential TaskMaster commands from .taskmaster/CLAUDE.md
   - Quick reference format (command + 1-line description)
   - Only loaded when task-master commands are invoked

4. Create .claude-collective/research-framework.md (~60 lines):
   - Move content from research.md
   - Only loaded for research/analysis tasks

5. Create .claude-collective/hook-guide.md (~25 lines):
   - Extract from hooks.md
   - Only loaded for hook debugging

6. Update CLAUDE.md imports to reference new structure
7. Test: Verify files parse correctly with @ imports
tasks.testStrategy:
Validation:
- INDEX.md <= 100 lines (target 95, expanded from 80 to include behavioral rules)
- INDEX.md contains '## Behavioral Rules' section with 6 rules from Insights report
- Each JIT file within size targets
- @ imports resolve correctly in Claude Code
- No syntax errors in markdown
- grep '@\.' *.md succeeds for all imports
- Manual test: load CLAUDE.md, verify INDEX.md appears with behavioral rules, verify JIT files DON'T appear until triggered

tasks.title: Rewrite load-behavioral-system.sh for minimal context loading
tasks.description: Transform startup hook from loading 738 lines to loading only ~120 lines (INDEX.md + DECISION.md), implementing true JIT loading pattern
tasks.details:
Implementation:
1. Rewrite .claude/hooks/load-behavioral-system.sh (~20 lines):
   ```bash
   #!/bin/bash
   echo "🚀 DRUPAL CLAUDE COLLECTIVE v2.0"
   echo "=== COLLECTIVE INDEX (.claude-collective/INDEX.md) ==="
   cat .claude-collective/INDEX.md
   echo ""
   echo "=== DECISION ENGINE (.claude-collective/DECISION.md) ==="
   cat .claude-collective/DECISION.md
   echo ""
   echo "✅ Collective Ready - JIT Loading Active"
   ```

2. Remove all other file loads (agents.md, hooks.md, quality.md, research.md, CLAUDE.md, .taskmaster/CLAUDE.md)

3. Update hook to display new branding/version (v2.0.0)

4. Ensure executable permissions preserved

5. Test with wc -l to verify output < 150 lines total
tasks.testStrategy:
Validation:
- Hook script <= 25 lines
- Hook output <= 150 lines total (INDEX.md ~80 + DECISION.md ~35 + formatting ~35)
- Startup time < 1 second
- No file not found errors
- Manual test: restart Claude Code, check system-reminder length
- Compare: v1.x startup = 738 lines, v2.0 startup <= 150 lines (80% reduction achieved)

tasks.title: Update DECISION.md with DDC-style explicit decision tree
tasks.description: Refactor DECISION.md to include clearer decision logic following DDC (Decision-Driven Claude) pattern with explicit routing rules
tasks.details:
Implementation:
1. Keep existing auto-delegation infrastructure (lines 1-35)

2. Add explicit decision tree section:
   ```markdown
   ## ROUTING DECISION TREE
   
   IF: Drupal module/theme/config development
     THEN: Load van-context.md, route to specialized Drupal agent
   
   IF: task-master command invoked
     THEN: Load taskmaster-reference.md on demand
   
   IF: Research/analysis request
     THEN: Load research-framework.md, use @research-agent
   
   IF: Hook debugging needed
     THEN: Load hook-guide.md
   
   IF: Normal conversation
     THEN: Use standard Claude behavior + auto-delegation capability
   ```

3. Clarify when JIT loading occurs vs. startup loading

4. Fix any remaining contradictions from the 6 identified issues

5. Target: ~40-45 lines total (slight expansion for clarity)
tasks.testStrategy:
Validation:
- DECISION.md <= 50 lines
- All 6 contradictions documented in PRD are resolved
- Decision tree is explicit and unambiguous
- No overlap with INDEX.md or van-context.md content
- Manual review: read top to bottom, verify logical flow
- Cross-reference with PRD section 'Documentation Contradictions'

tasks.title: Remove redundant hooks and add php-lint post-edit hook
tasks.description: Remove directive-enforcer.sh and routing-executor.sh, merge essential checks into load-behavioral-system.sh, and add a postToolUse hook for PHP syntax checking after edits (from Insights report). Reduces total hook count while adding high-impact auto-linting.
tasks.details:
Implementation:
1. Remove .claude/hooks/directive-enforcer.sh (currently no-op or minimal value)
   - Review for any essential checks
   - Merge critical checks into load-behavioral-system.sh if needed

2. Remove .claude/hooks/routing-executor.sh (already a no-op per PRD)
   - Confirm no active logic
   - Remove from settings.json hook configuration

3. NEW: Add postToolUse php-lint hook to settings.json:
   - Trigger on Edit|Write tool calls
   - Run php -l on modified .php/.module/.inc files
   - This addresses the #1 friction point from Insights report: 26 buggy code events, many from missing service injections, wrong DB table names, and syntax errors that php -l would catch

     ```json
     { "matcher": "Edit|Write", "command": "if echo $CC_EDIT_FILE_PATH | grep -qE '\\.(php|module|inc|install|theme)$'; then php -l $CC_EDIT_FILE_PATH 2>&1 | tail -1; fi" }
     ```
   - Add to both .claude/settings.json and templates/settings.json.template

4. Update .claude/settings.json:
   - Remove directive-enforcer from hook configuration
   - Remove routing-executor from hook configuration
   - Add postToolUse php-lint hook
   - Keep: load-behavioral-system, test-driven-handoff, collective-metrics, block-destructive-commands

tasks.title: Create custom workflow skills from Insights report patterns
tasks.description: Create custom Claude Code skills (/implement, /update-docs, /verify-changes) that encode the high-impact workflow patterns identified by the Claude Code Insights usage report, addressing multi-file verification gaps and documentation drift.
tasks.details:
Implementation:
1. Create .claude/commands/implement.md skill:
   - Encodes the plan-then-execute workflow that 74% of successful sessions used
   - Steps: read plan file, grep codebase for ALL files referencing changed functions/services, implement across ALL files, run php -l on modified PHP files, grep for hardcoded magic numbers and replace with config values, verify Twig filters exist, write output to project directory, commit
   - Addresses: 40 multi-file change successes + 26 buggy code frictions
   - Usage: /implement <plan-file-or-description>

2. Create .claude/commands/update-docs.md skill:
   - Encodes the documentation sync workflow (23 sessions dedicated to docs)
   - Steps: check recent git commits, diff against semantic docs/CHANGELOG/feature index, update any stale documentation, verify accuracy against actual source code, commit doc updates
   - Addresses: documentation drift found in 3+ sessions
   - Usage: /update-docs [since-commit-or-timeframe]

3. Create .claude/commands/verify-changes.md skill:
   - Encodes the post-implementation verification pass
   - Steps: grep for remaining references to old names/values, check all service injections, verify DB table/column names, confirm Twig filter existence, check for missed locations
   - Addresses: #1 friction - Claude missing files in multi-file changes
   - Usage: /verify-changes

4. Add all 3 skills to templates/commands/ for installation

5. Update lib/file-mapping.js getCommandMapping() to include new skills

6. Update INDEX.md command catalog to list new skills

7. Reference: Claude Code Insights report patterns section and CLAUDE.md suggestions section
